amends.rule: the S47 amendment is not edited. This registration corrects two P19.9 implementation defects before any P19.9 arm is trained: the router's decision ordering and the outcome supervision label.

status: implemented and CPU-tested; not trained, not sampled, no GPU job started

correction_1_pre_read_decision.defect: the registered feature list encouraged a router that consumes r_t, so the gate could only be computed after the memory read had already been fetched; a compute-saving route whose decision follows the compute is not a route
correction_1_pre_read_decision.mechanism: PreReadUtilityRouter predicts Delta_t from h_t and compact metadata (position_fraction, budget_fraction) plus a bounded hidden-norm scalar. It has no r_t, read_norm or gate_t input. `select` returns a boolean mask and the caller fetches memory only for masked tokens.

api.select: select(hidden_states, metadata, cost, threshold) -> (mask, Delta_hat, gate)
api.init: the predictor's last layer is zero, so the untrained gate is sigmoid(-cost/tau), reported rather than assumed to be identity

post_read_gate.rule: the pre-read prediction is always formed first; when enabled, the post-read prediction is added in logit space so a fetched read can close the gate but the post stage cannot cause a fetch the pre stage rejected
post_read_gate.disabled_contract: with use_post_read=false the read cannot change the gate

leakage_rules: pre-read metadata may contain only position_fraction and budget_fraction
r_t, read_norm and gate_t are post-read-only and raise when passed to the pre-read predictor
target, target_id, y_t, answer, gold, label, delta, base_loss, memory_loss and teacher_logprob remain forbidden
metadata fractions must be finite and in [0, 1]

correction_2_counterfactual_outcome_supe.defect: the registered verified-outcome label was an absolute correctness bit broadcast to a sequence's tokens; it cannot distinguish a token that helps from a token in a sequence that happened to be correct
correction_2_counterfactual_outcome_supe.label: Delta_outcome = P(correct | memory) - P(correct | base)
correction_2_counterfactual_outcome_supe.estimator: over paired rollouts for the same prompt, each side separately verified; the label is the memory success frequency minus the base success frequency

controls.verified-outcome: retained as the absolute-label control; it is a registered source but not the outcome route

rejections: a top-level absolute verified field is rejected for counterfactual-outcome

split_and_leakage.overlap: a prompt id may not appear in both fit and holdout

what_this_registration_does_not_establis: that the pre-read router improves routing: it is implemented and CPU-tested, not trained
that the paired counterfactual outcome label beats the absolute control: that is the registered experiment
that the cost term is calibrated: price_per_element and latency come from a runtime receipt before any arm runs
that P19.9 beats the current gate at equal tokens: no arm has run

literature.advantage_based_on_policy_distillation: Sabbaghi, Pappas, Hassani, Javanmard, arXiv:2610.31563 (2026-10-22): counterfactual advantage under the student as a teacher-action weight. PARTIAL for this implementation: paired verified rollouts estimate a prompt-level outcome difference, not a token-level action advantage.
literature.verified_rollout_gating: Jiang, Xie, Jiang, Zhang, SKALD, arXiv:2608.09826 (2026-08-10): gating distillation on verified rollout advantage. PARTIAL: the gate here is a learned function of causal features, not an empirical threshold on rollout groups.
